Product description

Smart Memory: Turn the lamp on again, it will be in the same color mode as when it was last turned off.

For All Occasions: 6500K for working mode, 4500K for reading mode, 3500K for relaxing, 3200K for sleeping.

Eye-Caring LED Lamp: No glare, No flickering, No ultraviolet rays, No frequency radiation

Not only a LED Desk Lamp, but also a Deskop Power Strip Charging Station

  • This desktop power strip can charge 7 devices simultaneously, whether the lamp is on or off, and keep them within reach. Building your own working station.
  • It can auto-detects your connected devices and can reach faster charging efficiency. USB-C port can up to 15W/5V/3A max . Each USB A port provide 5V/2.4A max.

Touch Lamp

Touch Sensor Switch is applied to this desk lamp, sliding touch dimming, the light intensity can be adjusted freely

  • Touch switch to turn on/off
  • Touch ∧ to increase brightness
  • Touch ∨ to decrease brightness
  • Touch M to choose color mode

Multi-Angle Adjustable Table Lamp

The lamp for desk can 180° adjustable up and down, right and left, allowing you to fine-tune the light direction for greater lighting range and flexibility

Plug In and Use

45° low profile right angled flat plug and 5 feet extension cord, making the light reach to where you needed

Multi-protection with surge protection protector for your devices

    Customer Reviews, including Product Star Ratings help customers to learn more about the product and decide whether it is the right product for them.
